title: Real-time resource management improves reliability and efficiency for Sappi Fine Paper
summary: At its Somerset mill, Sappi Fine Paper uses PI System data to decide whether to buy more grid energy or raise steam production in its own boiler.
challenge: There was no visibility into operations data, while regulators and shareholders pressed for better energy performance.
solution: PI System informs the buy-versus-generate decision, balancing generated and purchased power.

outcomes.text: Optimised grid energy purchases (no figure given)
"Over 80 percent of total use comes from renewable sources"

title: AVEVA PI System gives Klabin a bird's-eye view into paper production
summary: Klabin, Brazil's largest paper and pulp producer and exporter, built real-time digital models of pulp production, from tree harvesting through drying, on 85,000 variables in PI.
challenge: More than 25,000 assets, and evaluating proposed production changes took hours.
solution: Integrated digital models in PI System, with integrator IHM.

outcomes.text: Production up 3,400 air-dry tons per year
Maintenance costs cut by nearly $10 million

title: More efficient operations for more sustainable outcomes
summary: Ence built a control-loop monitoring tool for its pulp mills from PI AF and event frames, and uses CONNECT with deep-learning models to predict river flow and plan water use.
challenge: Process variability, and downtime in summer caused by water shortage.
solution: AF and event frame loop diagnostics shown in PI Vision; water data contextualised in AF and published to CONNECT for river-flow prediction.

outcomes.text: Summer water-shortage downtime from 15 days to zero
Nearly 900 manual interventions avoided per day

verifyNote: The energy figure is inconsistent: the outcome says 1,500 MWh per pulp mill, but the body says "1,500 MWs per hour per year".
